scripts.dev: npm run build -w @escape/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @escape/shared && npm run build -w @escape/server && npm run build -w @escape/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @escape/shared && npm run typecheck -w @escape/server && npm run typecheck -w @escape/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @escape/shared && npm run test -w @escape/server
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @escape/shared && npm run demo -w @escape/server
